Overview

Cuernavaca is a city in Morelos with a population of 378,476. The City of Eternal Spring with lush gardens, historic palaces, and a large expat community. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
